description: This file implements a service class for interacting with Mistral's API using an OpenAI-compatible interface. It extends an existing OpenAILLMService to customize message handling, client creation, and function call execution specifically for Mistral. The class includes methods for applying Mistral-specific message fix-ups, building chat completion parameters, and filtering function calls to prevent duplicates.
